records.reason: Spellshape that changes the next healing spell's effect on its TARGETS (extra HP, a counteract attempt); nothing on the caster's sheet changes.
Reduces an ongoing poison's stage after a save; affliction stages are tracked at the table and no check bonus is granted.
Adds a counteract attempt against an affliction on the TARGET of Healing Transformation; target-side only.
An impulse action whose effect (invisible/concealed until end of next turn, Sustain) is applied and resolved at the table.
An activity: several Shove checks plus a Stride, all resolved at the table; no standing modifier.
Reaction granting an extra Strike on a trigger; an action resolved at the table.
Broadens which prepared spell may be expended for Counterspell — a rules permission adjudicated in play, with no sheet value to change.
Reaction granting a Step or Stride that avoids reactions; movement resolved at the table.
Simple Interact actions at reach via your shadow; explicitly excludes anything requiring a check, so nothing is computable.
Downgrades severe cold/heat environmental effects; the app models no environmental-exposure lane and no legal field covers it.
Reaction granting an unarmed Strike on a trigger; resolved at the table.
An action that hangs onto a foe, escaped against your existing Acrobatics DC; positional and table-resolved.
Grants Drape Ambient Magic, which lives in core.json's `actions` map (not `feats`, so grantsFeats cannot reference it); its concealment effect is resolved at the table.
A two-action Strike with an extra damage die plus an automatic Shove and prone; all resolved inside that action at the table.
Free action granting quickened for the turn with restricted use; a condition applied in play.
Grants the Empty Vessel reaction, also an `actions` record rather than a feat; its once-per-day benefit is resolved at the table.
Grants scaling temporary Hit Points from an archetype activity; temp HP is entered on the HP control when gained and no legal field expresses it.
Permission to share a square with a Small ally; pure positioning, nothing on the sheet.
Gives whoever drinks your healing elixir an attempt to end persistent bleed; drinker-side and table-resolved.
Removes the flat check against fog/mist concealment; flat checks are rolled at the table and no sense id in the legal list covers fog-sight.
Multiplies Long/High Jump distance derived from an Athletics result; jump distance is not a sheet statistic.
Permission to Stride over air/water for a turn; a movement permission on the map, not a fly/climb speed.
A standing rider on the player's own unarmed Strikes (+1d4 persistent acid on a critical hit) that nothing surfaces; the registry already records dice riders this way (see artery-map, fox-arson).

situational.when: on a critical hit with an unarmed attack

records.reason: Environment-gated Step permission plus off-guard on enemies; both are terrain/target side and the registry does not record off-guard grants.
An area action forcing saves and forced movement on other creatures; entirely target-side.
Rest-based healing and a near-death reprieve tied to a physical coffin; downtime/GM adjudication the app does not model.
Reaction suppressing one mental effect for a round; effect/condition handling is resolved at the table.
Reaction reducing an incoming critical hit to normal damage; damage resolution happens at the table, no standing modifier.
Changes how fast the armor innovation is donned and its Bulk while stowed; an in-play item state, not a character statistic.
Turns the construct companion into a carryable object; companion-side transport bookkeeping.
Reaction that damages a wall and the creature beneath it; entirely target/GM side.
Extends Thrash damage to a second enemy against your existing class DC; target-side only.
Removes off-guard while Climbing and relaxes the free-hand requirement; situational condition/requirement handling the sheet does not track.
A Strike that also applies grabbed to the target; an action resolved at the table.

Permanently improves the player's own finisher Strikes by lowering their multiple attack penalty (-4/-3 and -8/-6 instead of -5/-10); the engine models no MAP lane at all (no flurry/MAP handling exists in src) and no legal field expresses it.
Reaction melding you into an ALLY's polymorph; enlarge and temporary HP all land on the ally.
Removes the cap on simultaneous Pistolero's Challenges; challenges are tracked in play, not on the sheet.
Reaction moving frightened/stupefied values from adjacent allies onto you; condition bookkeeping done in play.
An aura affecting other creatures' saves, targeting choices and Hide; nothing modifies your own statistics.
Spellshape replacing Harm's effect with a control effect on an undead target; entirely target-side.
Reaction swapping fleeing for stupefied 1 and lowering frightened by 1; condition substitution resolved in play.
Sends extra Hit Points to another willing creature when you cast Heal; ally-side benefit.
Lets allies spend actions to extend your Spin a Tale; the effect lives in other characters' action economy.
Trades one of your actions for an extra animal-companion action; action economy resolved at the table.
Grants temporary Hit Points when you become fully satiated (a Glutton for Flesh state the app does not track); temp HP is entered when gained.
A once-per-10-minutes transcendence action that makes an ikon cast Heal or Harm; an activity resolved at the table, not a per-day innate spell.

The immanence gives the player's own melee weapon ikon the reach trait (or +10 feet of reach if it already had reach) — a real change to that weapon's strike entry — and no legal field can grant or alter a weapon trait; the ikon entries in situationalBonuses.ts can only carry numeric bonuses (see gaze-sharp-as-steel).
Spellshape adding the subtle trait to your next spell; a trait on a cast, adjudicated at the table.
Makes enemies off-guard against your ranged attacks while you are in water; off-guard is a target-side condition the registry deliberately does not record.
Substitutes Thievery for Stealth when Concealing an Object; a per-activity skill substitution with no bonus and no field to express it.
Requires a partner's readied Strike and pools two characters' rolls; resolved between players at the table.
An impulse whose resistance and Shock-rune benefit go to ALLIES adjacent to the sphere; nothing accrues to the player.
Reaction redirecting electricity damage onto another creature; target-side, and it explicitly does not reduce the damage you take.
An action casting heal/harm from an existing slot with extra dice on the target; target-side and table-resolved.

The player recovers 2 Focus Points when they Refocus instead of 1 (having spent 2+). The sheet's Refocus control restores exactly 1 point (src/sheet/SpellsTab.tsx), focusPoolBonus only changes pool size, and no legal field expresses a Refocus recovery amount.
The player recovers 3 Focus Points when they Refocus instead of 1 (having spent 3+); same missing lane — Refocus recovery amount is hard-coded to 1 and no field encodes it.
Spellshape spending a Focus Point to add damage to a spell aimed at an undead; the extra damage lands on the target.
An aura forcing Will saves on undead that end their turn near you; entirely target-side.
Denies flanking by creatures of your level or lower; flanking and the resulting off-guard are positional and applied at the table.
An eidolon action dealing damage to a grabbed creature against your existing spell DC; target-side.
